name: Accessory Consistency
description: Analyzes accessory rendering consistency in 動画
algorithm: Accessory Consistency — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes temporal consistency of accessories (glasses, earrings, hats) across video frames for deepfake detection:

1. **Accessory検出&トラッキング**: Facial landmarks and object detection are used to identify accessories in each frame — glasses frames, earring positions, hat contours, and other wearable items. Each accessory is tracked across consecutive frames using optical flow and bounding box correlation.

2. **幾何学的一貫性分析**: The geometric properties of detected accessories (shape, aspect ratio, symmetry) are measured per frame. In authentic video, accessories maintain consistent geometry modulated only by smooth head pose changes. Deepfakes often produce frame-to-frame geometric fluctuations in accessories due to imperfect face-swapping at boundaries.

3. **テクスチャ&Appearance安定性**: Accessory surface textures (reflective properties of glasses lenses, metallic sheen of jewelry) are tracked. Real accessories show physically coherent appearance changes with lighting. Deepfake generators frequently fail to maintain consistent accessory rendering, producing flickering or morphing artifacts.

4. **境界コヒーレンスCheck**: The edges where accessories meet skin/hair are examined. Authentic boundaries show consistent occlusion relationships and natural blending. Face-swap artifacts typically produce irregular boundary rendering — glasses frames may partially merge with skin, or earrings may appear to clip through hair.

5. **時間的異常スコアリング**: Statistical measures of accessory consistency (variance of geometric features, temporal gradient of appearance) are computed. High variance or sudden discontinuities across otherwise smooth motion sequences indicate manipulation, yielding an elevated forensic score.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through accessory consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
